Move falling pieces into position, complete horizontal rows and keep the board from filling up.
Simple move and rotate controls
Use responsive touch controls to position and rotate pieces as you plan each move.
Clear rows and build your score
Complete full rows to clear space, earn points and keep your game going.
Increasing challenge and scoring
Follow your score and level as the pace increases and every placement matters.
Play offline, whenever you like
Enjoy Tetrixa without an internet connection, whether you have a few minutes or more time to play.
faq: What is Tetrixa?
Tetrixa is a mobile block-puzzle arcade game. Arrange falling pieces, complete rows and aim for a higher score.
Can I play Tetrixa offline?
Yes. The Google Play listing describes Tetrixa as a complete offline game, so you can play without an internet connection.
How do I play?
Move and rotate the falling pieces to fit them into the board. Complete horizontal rows to clear them and earn points.
Does the game get harder?
The store listing describes gradually increasing difficulty. As you progress, the pace becomes more challenging.
Does Tetrixa have touch controls?
Yes. Tetrixa includes simple touch controls designed for mobile play.
Does Tetrixa contain ads?
Yes. Google Play identifies Tetrixa as an app that contains ads.
Is Tetrixa free to download?
The Google Play listing offers the game for installation. Check the current store page for any purchase or in-app item details.
Where can I install Tetrixa?
Install the official Android version from the Tetrixa listing on Google Play.

Tetrixa est un jeu mobile d’arcade et de puzzle de blocs. Placez les pièces, complétez des lignes et visez un meilleur score.
Puis-je jouer hors ligne ?
Oui. La fiche Google Play présente Tetrixa comme un jeu entièrement hors ligne.
Comment jouer ?
Déplacez et faites pivoter les pièces pour les placer sur le plateau. Complétez des lignes horizontales pour gagner des points.
Le jeu devient-il plus difficile ?
La fiche indique une difficulté qui augmente progressivement.
Le jeu propose-t-il des commandes tactiles ?
Oui. Tetrixa comprend des commandes tactiles simples pour mobile.
Tetrixa contient-il des publicités ?

Le téléchargement est-il gratuit ?
Consultez la fiche Google Play pour connaître les conditions actuelles et les éventuels achats intégrés.
Où installer Tetrixa ?
Installez la version Android officielle depuis la fiche Tetrixa sur Google Play.

faq: What is Tetrixa?
Tetrixa is a mobile block-puzzle arcade game. Arrange falling pieces, complete rows and aim for a higher score.
Can I play Tetrixa offline?
Yes. The Google Play listing describes Tetrixa as a complete offline game, so you can play without an internet connection.
How do I play?
Move and rotate the falling pieces to fit them into the board. Complete horizontal rows to clear them and earn points.
Does the game get harder?
The store listing describes gradually increasing difficulty. As you progress, the pace becomes more challenging.
Does Tetrixa have touch controls?
Yes. Tetrixa includes simple touch controls designed for mobile play.
Does Tetrixa contain ads?
Yes. Google Play identifies Tetrixa as an app that contains ads.
Is Tetrixa free to download?
The Google Play listing offers the game for installation. Check the current store page for any purchase or in-app item details.
Where can I install Tetrixa?
Install the official Android version from the Tetrixa listing on Google Play.
